text:
maria_sre: Quick retrospective from last night's 503 wave — dropping a short summary and action items. We mitigated with temporary rate-limits and a fallback model rollout at 02:12 UTC.

alex_m: tl;dr — small group of customers sent very long seq requests (>16k tokens) and retried aggressively. KV cache warmed slowly -> massive KVMISS + batch queue growth -> gateway backlog -> 503s.

jin_oncall: Repro steps I used: hit the endpoint with a streaming request and 10 concurrent clients, seqlen 12k. Repro script: 
```bash
for i in {1..10}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"$(python -c \"print(\'A\' * 12000)\")","stream":false}' &
done
wait
```
Got 40-60% 503s after ~30s.

emily_support: Customer list: 3 paying customers triggered the pattern, one on continuous ingest. Support already reached out to two; one asked for workaround (trim seqs), flagged billing concerns.

sam_prod: Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler latency + prefix cache coldstart. When KV misses spike, GPU runtime spends extra time refilling caches and batcher timeouts propagate. Also saw proxy conn-pool exhaustion in logs.

opsbot: Deploy bot: rolled rwd-large->rwd-large-fallback (reduced recall) to eu-west at 02:12:24 UTC; traffic shifted to fallback by 02:15:03 UTC.

maria_sre: Action items I propose (owners / ETA):
- short: add per-tenant concurrent request limit and early sequence-length reject (emily_support / 48h)
- infra: increase proxy conn_pool and tune keepalive (jin_oncall / 72h)
- runtime: add KV warmup hints for large seq clients + prefetch config (alex_m / 2w)
- prod: create a customer-specific autoscale profile that weights latency over throughput (sam_prod / 1w)
- comms: reach out to affected customers with mitigation + billing credit offer (emily_support / today EOD)

qa_lola: I'll add regression tests to the perf-suite to simulate 10k+ token streams and ensure fallback triggers within SLO. ETA 5 days.

alex_m: Logs snippet showing KVMISS spike: 
```json
{"ts":"2025-06-18T01:58:12Z","tenant":"cust-42","kvmiss":1287,"batch_wait_ms":3450}
{"ts":"2025-06-18T01:58:18Z","tenant":"cust-42","kvmiss":1984,"batch_wait_ms":5100}
```
(we correlate with proxy 502/503 windows)

jin_oncall: Temporary mitigation checklist I did last night: 1) add 50qps per-tenant soft limit, 2) force fallback model routing for tenants with >5 sustained long-requests, 3) bump proxy max-conns for eu-west. Reduced 503s to <1% after 02:20.

emily_support: For billing/contact: proposed credit = 10% invoice adjustment for impacted window + recommended config docs. I'll draft message.

maria_sre: Notes on follow-up meeting: short sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm owners and timelines. Please update the issue tracker with the actions above and add links to reproducer + logs.

alex_m: One more technical note — add a runtime metric for "kvcache_fill_duration" per model to help alert earlier. I'll open the PR.

emily_support: I'll send the customer comms draft to @maria_sre and @sam_prod for review within 2 hours.

maria_sre: Thanks everyone. Quick wins: emily sends comms; jin does proxy tuning; alex opens kvcache metric PR. We reconvene after docs and PRs. :thumbsup:
